title: Kandy in 60 Seconds
subtitle: A cinematic flyover of the city's essential silhouette.
description: Five camera moves from the lake to the hills. The fastest way to understand how Kandy is laid out before you start exploring.

stops.headline: The lake at the centre
stops.note: Kandy was built around water and the palace. Everything radiates from here.

stops.headline: The sacred precinct
stops.note: The Temple of the Tooth sits inside the old royal palace grounds.

stops.headline: Above the city
stops.note: The white Buddha watches over the western ridge.

stops.headline: The postcard view
stops.note: Lake, temple and hills in one frame.

stops.headline: The green edge
stops.note: Forest reserve and the ridge that frames the valley.

title: Sacred Kandy
subtitle: Temples, monasteries and the living ritual of the city.
description: Follow the Buddhist geography of Kandy from the Temple of the Tooth to the two great monastic chapters and the hilltop Buddha.

stops.headline: Sri Dalada Maligawa
stops.note: The relic shrine and the daily thevava offering.

stops.headline: The royal palace
stops.note: The temple was built within the king's own compound.

stops.headline: Malwatte chapter
stops.note: One of the two fraternities guarding the relic tradition.

stops.headline: Asgiriya chapter
stops.note: Quieter monastic grounds north of the centre.

stops.headline: Bahirawakanda
stops.note: A modern pilgrimage site with the city at its feet.

title: Kandy Lake Loop
subtitle: A short walk around the water and the old city edge.
description: A practical micro-tour you can follow on foot: lake path, temple, church and the colonial hotel frontage.

stops.headline: Kiri Muhuda
stops.note: The 1807 lake and its royal bathing island.

stops.headline: North shore
stops.note: The temple precinct opens directly onto the lake.

stops.headline: St. Paul's
stops.note: A quiet Anglican church from the garrison era.

stops.headline: Colonial frontage
stops.note: The long veranda facing the lake.

stops.headline: Above the loop
stops.note: Climb the ridge for the whole circuit in one view.

title: Historic Kandy
subtitle: Kingdom, colony and the layers between.
description: From the royal palace to the garrison cemetery, this tour traces the political history of the city in five stops.

stops.headline: The last kingdom
stops.note: Kandy held out against colonial powers longer than any other Sri Lankan kingdom.

stops.headline: Objects of the court
stops.note: Royal and craft collections in the palace complex.

stops.headline: The colonial junction
stops.note: Civic Kandy reorganised around the station and the clock.

stops.headline: Garrison cemetery
stops.note: Memorials to soldiers, planters and administrators.

stops.headline: Before Kandy
stops.note: The 14th-century Gampola temples west of the city.

title: Scenic Kandy
subtitle: Ridges, tea gardens and the best light of the day.
description: A hill-focused tour for photographers and anyone who wants to see the valley from above.

stops.headline: The classic angle
stops.note: Lake and temple from the western ridge.

stops.headline: Hilltop frame
stops.note: The city spreads north and east below the statue.
